# Panel Furniture Designer

> Free, local-first browser app for designing panel furniture in 3D and generating a complete build document: cut list, cutting layout, drilling plans, hardware list and step-by-step assembly instructions. No account, no server, no telemetry — designs stay on the user's device.

- Canonical URL: https://free.openfurniture.de/
- Languages: English and German
- Price: free, no account required
- Platform: any modern desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox; WebGL2 for the 3D view)
- Imprint: https://free.openfurniture.de/#/imprint

## What it does

The app is a parametric design tool for cabinetmakers, woodworkers and DIY builders. The user picks a template or starts from a blank carcass, sets overall dimensions, plinth, columns, shelves, doors, drawers, handles, materials and hardware profiles, and edits the design in a live 3D preview. Validation errors block outputs; warnings link to the field that fixes them.

## Templates

- Bookcase: 800 × 2000 × 300 mm, two columns, fixed and adjustable shelves.
- Cabinet: 800 × 900 × 450 mm, plinth, double door, two adjustable shelves.
- Sideboard: 1600 × 800 × 450 mm, plinth, two doors and three drawers.
- Chest of drawers: 800 × 1000 × 450 mm, plinth, four drawers.
- Wardrobe: 1000 × 2200 × 600 mm, plinth, clothes rail, shelves, three doors.
- Blank carcass: 600 × 720 × 400 mm, one empty section.

## Outputs

- Cut list with cut sizes, edge banding and area per material.
- Cutting layout that places parts on as few boards as possible, with adjustable board size, saw kerf and edge trim.
- Hardware list including spares.
- Drilling plans to scale with hole tables.
- Step-by-step assembly instructions with tools, safety callouts and 3D illustrations.
- A4 print document with cover, safety notes, materials summary, cut list, hardware, tools, drilling plans and steps; can be saved as PDF.

## Privacy and storage

Everything runs in the browser. Designs are stored locally in the browser (IndexedDB), never uploaded. Designs can be exported and imported as `.furniture.json` files. There is no analytics or telemetry.

## Limitations

- Millimetres only; `.` and `,` both work as the decimal separator.
- Desktop browsers only; Safari is best-effort and not verified.
- Generated documents are a planning aid, not an engineering or safety approval. Verify dimensions, material strength, wall fixings and applicable safety rules before cutting or building.

## Links

- [Open the app](https://free.openfurniture.de/): start a new design or load a template.
- [Imprint](https://free.openfurniture.de/#/imprint): provider contact details.
